requirements.businessContext: This module owns three squad-shape mechanics that sit outside the player-bidding flow: (1) bonus-slot purchases that raise the 15-player squad cap up to a hard ceiling of 18 (slots 16/17/18 cost £10M/£20M/£30M respectively, Complete tier only, only after the initial player auction has completed); (2) penalty-slot redemption, which buys back a squad slot lost via a missed nomination, with redemption priced by whether the penalty was incurred in the current auction cycle (£2.5M) or a previous one (£5M); and (3) the optional PL Club Auction — a separate auction session (type='club-auction') that runs BEFORE the initial player auction when the league has clubAuctionEnabled=true, allocates one PL club per fantasy team (and one fantasy team per PL club) at a £500K floor over a two-round randomised queue, and snapshots the club's tier (top8/mid/promoted) for downstream synergy and result-bonus scoring (scoring math itself is owned by module 11).

userStories.asA: team owner in a Complete-tier auction league
userStories.iWant: to unlock additional bonus squad slots (16, 17, 18) by spending purse money after the initial auction completes
userStories.soThat: I can expand my squad beyond the base 15-player cap up to the absolute ceiling of 18

userStories.asA: team owner who incurred a penalty slot
userStories.iWant: to view my outstanding penalty rows and the current redemption price for each
userStories.soThat: I can decide which penalty to buy back and when it's cheapest to do so

userStories.iWant: to redeem a single penalty slot by paying from purse
userStories.soThat: my effective squad cap is restored by one slot

userStories.asA: team owner in any auction league
userStories.iWant: to see the set of FPL players and PL clubs already owned by teams in my league plus per-team purse and ownership detail
userStories.soThat: the auction lobby and nomination-order tables show me who has bought what

userStories.asA: league admin in a club-auction-enabled league
userStories.iWant: to create a single club-auction session before the initial player auction
userStories.soThat: every team in the league has a chance to own one PL club whose results feed into per-GW bonus scoring

userStories.asA: league admin running a live club auction
userStories.iWant: the system to auto-nominate the next PL club from a randomised queue when no bid is open
userStories.soThat: the club auction progresses without each team having to take a turn

userStories.asA: team owner during the club auction
userStories.iWant: to be the highest bidder when an open club nomination's timer expires
userStories.soThat: I take ownership of that PL club for the season, with its tier snapshotted at purchase

userStories.asA: league admin running a simulated auction league
userStories.iWant: the club-auction session to auto-allocate one PL club per team at the floor price when started
userStories.soThat: simulated leagues can short-circuit live bidding while still producing valid club ownerships

userStories.asA: team owner who lost a club bid
userStories.iWant: unsold clubs from round 1 to be re-queued randomly for a second-pass round
userStories.soThat: every PL club gets at least two chances to be sold before the club auction completes

userStories.asA: team that already owns a PL club
userStories.iWant: to be excluded from bidding on further clubs
userStories.soThat: the one-club-per-team rule is enforced and round-2 bidding is reserved for club-less teams

userStories.iWant: the club auction session to mark itself completed once all teams own a club or round 2 has exhausted unsold clubs
userStories.soThat: the initial player auction is unblocked and a completion snapshot is taken

userStories.asA: winning bidder of a PL club
userStories.iWant: to receive a 'club_purchased' notification confirming the club, tier and price
userStories.soThat: I have an audit trail of my purchase and know my season-long team-display name

userStories.asA: team owner who just unlocked or redeemed a slot
userStories.iWant: to receive a notification with the cost and new cap / remaining penalty count
userStories.soThat: I can confirm the deduction happened

businessRules.rule: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot requires either a valid team session cookie or a superadmin cookie; otherwise responds 401 'Authentication required'.
POST /api/auction/unlock-slot requires a string teamId in the body; missing/non-string returns 400 'teamId is required'.
A team session may only unlock slots for its own team; mismatched session.id vs body teamId returns 403 'Can only unlock slots for your own team'. Superadmin is exempt.
Unknown teamId returns 404 'Team not found'.
Unlock is rejected with 400 'Not an auction league' when the team's league.format is not 'auction'.
Slot expansion is blocked at the API for Primary-tier leagues (`auctionTier='primary'`) with 403 'Slot expansion is not available in Primary tier'; only Complete-tier leagues may unlock bonus slots.
Maximum bonus slots per team is 3 (MAX_BONUS_SLOTS); reaching the cap returns 400 'All bonus slots already unlocked (squad cap 18)' (= MAX_SQUAD_SIZE 15 + MAX_BONUS_SLOTS 3).
Bonus-slot pricing is sequential: 1st unlock (slot 16) costs £10M, 2nd (slot 17) £20M, 3rd (slot 18) £30M. nextBonusSlotCost(bonusSlots) returns the next price or null when at cap.
Unlock requires that an 'initial' auction session exists for the league; otherwise responds 409 'Cannot unlock bonus slots before the initial auction has been created'.

Unlock requires the initial auction session status to be 'completed'; if status is pending/active/paused it returns 409 'Cannot unlock bonus slots while the initial auction is in progress — must wait until it completes'.

Available purse = initialBudget + totalIncome + totalRefunds − totalSpent (calculatePurse). Unlock rejects with 400 'Insufficient purse: need £X.XXM, have £Y.YYM' when available purse < next unlock cost.

On successful unlock, in a single DB transaction: (a) decrement teams.purse by cost, (b) increment teams.totalSpent by cost, (c) increment teams.bonusSlots by 1, (d) insert a teamSlotUnlocks audit row with leagueId, teamId, slotNumber (MAX_SQUAD_SIZE + previous bonusSlots + 1 ⇒ 16/17/18), cost and unlockedAt. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — purse column is decremented separately from the calculatePurse-derived available purse, creating dual bookkeeping that can drift from the canonical formula.
Successful unlock response body is { success:true, bonusSlots:<new>, newCap:<15+bonusSlots>, spent:<cost>, nextUnlockCost:<next-or-null> }.

After unlock, a best-effort 'slot_unlocked' notification is created with title 'Unlocked slot <N>' and a body stating the deduction and new cap. Notification failures are logged but never fail the unlock response.
GET /api/auction/redeem-slot?teamId=<id> requires an authenticated session (any type) and a teamId query param; otherwise 401 Unauthorized or 400 'teamId is required'.
Penalty redemption pricing: £2.5M (SAME_CYCLE_COST) when penalty.incurredCycle === currentCycle, otherwise £5M (LATER_CYCLE_COST). priceForPenalty implements this rule.
currentCycle is the cycleNumber of any active/paused session for the league, falling back to the maximum cycleNumber across the league's sessions, falling back to 0 when no sessions exist.

GET /api/auction/redeem-slot returns { currentCycle, penalties: [{ id, incurredCycle, sessionId, cost, createdAt }], legacyUnledgeredSlots, legacyCost: £5M } — penalties are unredeemed rows ordered by createdAt ASC, plus a legacyUnledgeredSlots count for pre-migration penalties without ledger rows.

POST /api/auction/redeem-slot requires a team session whose id matches body.teamId; superadmin sessions and other-team sessions are rejected with 401 'Team authentication required' or 403 'Not authorized'. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — POST excludes superadmin while POST /unlock-slot allows it, creating an asymmetric admin-support contract.
Redemption requires teams.penaltySlots > 0; otherwise 400 'No penalty slots to redeem'.

If body.penaltyId is provided it must match an unredeemed penalty for the team; otherwise 404 'Penalty not found or already redeemed'. If omitted, the cheapest unredeemed penalty is chosen (sorted by cost ASC, then incurredCycle ASC).
Legacy fallback: if teams.penaltySlots>0 but no ledger rows exist, redemption charges £5M (LATER_CYCLE_COST) with no row to mark redeemed.
Redemption purse check uses calculatePurse(initialBudget,totalIncome,totalSpent,totalRefunds); insufficient purse returns 400 'Insufficient purse. Redemption costs £X.XXM'.

On successful redemption, in a single DB transaction: (a) set teamPenalties.redeemedAt=now and redemptionPrice=cost on the chosen row (if any), (b) decrement teams.penaltySlots by 1, (c) increment teams.totalSpent by cost. // CODE-CONFIRMED: may be a defect — teams.purse column is NOT decremented here even though it IS decremented in unlock-slot, creating asymmetry and potential drift of the purse column from the canonical formula.

Redemption response body is { success:true, cost, incurredCycle, currentCycle, remainingPenaltySlots }, and a best-effort 'slot_redeemed' notification is created with a deep link to /<slug>/auction. Notification failures are logged but never fail the response.
GET /api/auction/league-owned?leagueId=<id> requires an authenticated session (any type) and a leagueId query param; the target league.format must be 'auction'.

GET /api/auction/league-owned returns { ownedElementIds:[fplElementId], ownerByElementId:{ id→teamId }, teamSummaries:{ teamId → { purse, penaltySlots, bonusSlots, players:[{fplElementId, playerName, purchasePrice}] } } }. Only auctionOwnership rows with status='active' are included; purse is calculated via calculatePurse.
A club-auction session is only allowed when leagues.clubAuctionEnabled=true; creation otherwise returns 400 'Club auction is not enabled for this league'.
Only one club-auction session may exist per league; a second creation returns 409 'A club auction session already exists for this league'.

Session-ordering: club-auction → initial → mini-auction. A club-auction cannot be created after an initial session exists (409); an initial session cannot be created until any enabled club auction has status='completed' (409); a mini-auction requires a completed initial session.

Club-auction creation calls fetchAllPLClubsWithTiers (FPL bootstrap + standings config). Failures return 502 'Failed to load PL clubs from FPL'; an empty list returns 502 'FPL bootstrap returned no PL clubs'.

buildInitialClubQueue produces a randomly shuffled copy of the PL team IDs; the resulting array is stored in auctionSessions.snakeOrder as JSON, cycleNumber=1, currentNominatorIndex=0, status='pending'.

resolveClubBid calls resolveTier(plTeamId, plStandingsConfig). When resolveTier returns null (PL team id is in none of top8/mid/promoted — i.e., standings config is misconfigured or outdated), the route refuses to write an auctionClubOwnership row. The bid is left marked 'sold' with an audit-log entry, and a console.error is emitted with the failure context. Operator must repair the standings config and re-allocate via auction-corrections.
autoNominateNextClub is a no-op (returns null) unless the session is type='club-auction' AND status='active' AND has no open bid for the session.

Eligibility for the club auction: a team may bid only if it is non-ghost AND has no auctionClubOwnership row in the league (getClubLessTeamIds). When zero club-less teams remain the session is marked 'completed' immediately.

Queue exhaustion: when cursor exceeds queue.length on cycleNumber=1, the unsold-clubs list (PL IDs without an auctionClubOwnership row) is re-shuffled and stored as a new snakeOrder with currentNominatorIndex=0 and cycleNumber=2. When exhausted on cycle 2 (or no unsold clubs remain), the session status flips to 'completed' and writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot is invoked.

Each club nomination creates an auctionBids row with currentHighBid=minBid=£500K (CLUB_FLOOR_BID), fplElementId set to the PL team id, playerName set to the PL team name, status='open', and expiresAt=now+bidTimerSeconds. nominatorTeamId/currentHighBidderId are a sentinel (the first non-ghost team in the league), and a 'nomination' auctionBidLog row is inserted.

Club-bid resolution is idempotent and inspects auctionBidLogs.type='bid' rows: ≥1 real bid → 'sold' to currentHighBidderId, 0 real bids → 'unsold'. Status is flipped from 'open' atomically; an already-resolved bid returns 'already-resolved'.

resolveClubBid does NOT silently fall back to tier='mid' when resolveTier returns null. The previous fallback masked misconfigured standings (e.g., promoted teams not refreshed after season rollover) and resulted in clubs being assigned the wrong tier bonus. Now the fallback is loud — operator intervention required.

One-club-per-team and one-owner-per-club are enforced by uniqueIndex constraints (leagueId+teamId, leagueId+plTeamId) on auctionClubOwnership; the resolver's club-less filter prevents double-insertion under normal flow.
On SOLD a best-effort 'club_purchased' notification is created with title 'You bought <plTeamName>' and a body stating price (in M to 1dp) and tier. Failures are logged, never throwing.
On UNSOLD: update bid status='unsold' (atomic claim) and append an 'unsold' auctionBidLog with amount=0 and teamId=nominator (sentinel). No ownership row, no purse change.

advanceClubQueue advances currentNominatorIndex by 1 then calls autoNominateNextClub, which either nominates the next club or marks the session 'completed' (and writes a backup snapshot) when no more nominations are possible.

simulateClubAuction is the auto-allocator for isSimulated leagues: it shuffles non-ghost teams and the 20 PL clubs (with tier), pairs index-by-index up to min(teams.length, clubs.length), inserts auctionClubOwnership rows at the £500K floor, decrements purse / increments totalSpent per allocated team, then marks the session 'completed' and writes a snapshot. Pairings whose club.tier is null are skipped with a warning.

fetchAllPLClubsWithTiers expects exactly the 20 PL clubs from FPL bootstrap and resolves each through the active standings config (top8 length 8, mid length 9, promoted length 3 ⇒ 20 total). Returned rows include {id, name, short, tier|null}.
auctionClubOwnership snapshots plTeamName, plTeamShort and tier at purchase time so display and scoring survive future FPL bootstrap drift or standings-config edits.

Schema comments for teamSlotUnlocks.slotNumber and teams.bonusSlots correctly describe the current code: slot numbers 16/17/18, prices 10M/20M/30M, canonical pricing in src/lib/formats/auction/squad-rules.ts. No legacy 25M reference remains.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an unauthenticated request
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot is called with any body
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 with body { error: 'Authentication required' } and no DB writes occur

acceptanceCriteria.given: an authenticated team session for team A
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot is called with body.teamId = team B's id
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 with body.error 'Can only unlock slots for your own team'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin cookie
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot is called with another team's id
acceptanceCriteria.then: the request is accepted (admin bypass) and proceeds to the remaining checks

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Primary-tier auction league
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot is called for one of its teams
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 with body.error 'Slot expansion is not available in Primary tier' and bonusSlots is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Complete-tier team with bonusSlots = 3
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'All bonus slots already unlocked (squad cap 18)' and no DB writes occur

acceptanceCriteria.given: no initial auction session exists for the league
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Cannot unlock bonus slots before the initial auction has been created'

acceptanceCriteria.given: the initial auction session exists with status in {pending, active, paused}
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Cannot unlock bonus slots while the initial auction is in progress — must wait until it completes'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Complete-tier team with bonusSlots=0 and available purse £5M, initial auction completed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 with body.error matching 'Insufficient purse: need £10.00M, have £5.00M'

acceptanceCriteria.given: a Complete-tier team with bonusSlots=0, available purse ≥ £10M, initial auction completed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 200 with { success:true, bonusSlots:1, newCap:16, spent:10_000_000, nextUnlockCost:20_000_000 }, teams.bonusSlots becomes 1, teams.totalSpent increases by 10M, teams.purse decreases by 10M, a teamSlotUnlocks row {slotNumber:16, cost:10_000_000} is inserted, and a 'slot_unlocked' notification is created

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team with bonusSlots=1
acceptanceCriteria.then: the inserted teamSlotUnlocks row has slotNumber=17 and cost=20_000_000

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team with bonusSlots=2
acceptanceCriteria.then: the inserted teamSlotUnlocks row has slotNumber=18, cost=30_000_000 and the response.nextUnlockCost is null

acceptanceCriteria.given: the notifications service throws when called from POST /unlock-slot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is still 200 success and the failure is logged with prefix '[unlock-slot] notify slot_unlocked failed'

acceptanceCriteria.given: GET /api/auction/redeem-slot?teamId=<id> for an authenticated team
acceptanceCriteria.when: the team has two unredeemed penalties — one with incurredCycle=currentCycle, one with incurredCycle<currentCycle
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response contains penalties ordered by createdAt ASC, with costs £2_500_000 (current cycle) and £5_000_000 (older), plus the current cycle number

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team with penaltySlots=2 but only 1 teamPenalties row
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response includes legacyUnledgeredSlots=1 and legacyCost=5_000_000

acceptanceCriteria.given: a superadmin cookie (no team session)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 'Team authentication required' — admins cannot redeem on behalf of a team

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team session whose id ≠ body.teamId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 403 'Not authorized'

acceptanceCriteria.given: teams.penaltySlots=0
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'No penalty slots to redeem'

acceptanceCriteria.given: two unredeemed penalties — A (incurredCycle=current, cost £2.5M) and B (older, cost £5M)
acceptanceCriteria.then: row A is chosen (cheapest first), teamPenalties.redeemedAt and redemptionPrice are set on A, teams.penaltySlots decrements by 1, teams.totalSpent increases by 2_500_000, the response cost is 2_500_000

acceptanceCriteria.given: an unknown penaltyId or one already redeemed for the team
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/redeem-slot is called with that penaltyId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 404 'Penalty not found or already redeemed'

acceptanceCriteria.given: available purse < the chosen redemption cost
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 with body.error matching 'Insufficient purse. Redemption costs £X.XXM' and no DB writes occur

acceptanceCriteria.given: legacy state — penaltySlots>0 but no ledger rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: cost is £5M (LATER_CYCLE_COST), teams.penaltySlots decrements by 1, teams.totalSpent increases by 5_000_000, and no teamPenalties row is updated

acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful redemption
acceptanceCriteria.then: the body is { success:true, cost, incurredCycle, currentCycle, remainingPenaltySlots } and a 'slot_redeemed' notification is created with link '/<slug>/auction' when a slug exists

acceptanceCriteria.given: an unauthenticated GET /api/auction/league-owned?leagueId=...
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 401 Unauthorized

acceptanceCriteria.given: a non-auction league
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Not an auction league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an auction league with two teams and three active auctionOwnership rows plus one released row
acceptanceCriteria.then: ownedElementIds contains only the 3 active fplElementIds, ownerByElementId maps each to its teamId, and teamSummaries[teamId].purse equals calculatePurse(initialBudget,totalIncome,totalSpent,totalRefunds) with the correct players list and penaltySlots/bonusSlots

acceptanceCriteria.given: a league with clubAuctionEnabled=false
acceptanceCriteria.when: POST /api/auction/session is called with action='create' and type='club-auction'
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 400 'Club auction is not enabled for this league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an enabled league that already has a club-auction session
acceptanceCriteria.when: a second creation of type='club-auction' is attempted
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'A club auction session already exists for this league'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an enabled league with an initial auction already created
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Cannot create a club auction after an initial player auction has been scheduled. Allowed order: club-auction → initial → mini-auction.'

acceptanceCriteria.given: an enabled league whose club auction is not yet completed
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 409 'Club auction must be completed before creating the initial player auction…'

acceptanceCriteria.given: FPL bootstrap throws while creating a club auction
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is 502 'Failed to load PL clubs from FPL' and no auctionSessions row is inserted

acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful club-auction creation with 20 PL clubs returned
acceptanceCriteria.then: snakeOrder is a JSON array of 20 unique PL team IDs in randomised order, cycleNumber=1, currentNominatorIndex=0, status='pending', and the response is { success:true, id, queueLength:20 }

acceptanceCriteria.given: an active club-auction session with no open bid and the next queue entry maps to a known PL club
acceptanceCriteria.then: it inserts an auctionBids row (status='open', minBid=£500K, currentHighBid=£500K, expiresAt=now+bidTimerSeconds), an auctionBidLogs 'nomination' row, and returns the bidId

acceptanceCriteria.given: the session already has an 'open' auctionBids row
acceptanceCriteria.then: it returns null and inserts nothing

acceptanceCriteria.given: cursor reaches the end of the queue on cycleNumber=1 and at least one club is unsold
acceptanceCriteria.then: a re-shuffled queue of unsold PL clubs is written back to snakeOrder, currentNominatorIndex=0, cycleNumber=2, and nomination proceeds from the new cursor

acceptanceCriteria.given: cursor reaches the end of the queue on cycleNumber=2
acceptanceCriteria.then: the session status is updated to 'completed', writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot is invoked, and the function returns null

acceptanceCriteria.given: all teams in the league already own a club
acceptanceCriteria.then: the session status is updated to 'completed' immediately and no further nomination is created

acceptanceCriteria.given: a club bid resolves 'sold' but the plStandingsConfig does not contain the bid's plTeamId in any tier list
acceptanceCriteria.then: the auctionBids row is updated to 'sold'; an auctionBidLogs row is written for the audit trail; console.error is emitted with the leagueId and plTeamId context; NO auctionClubOwnership row is inserted; resolveClubBid returns 'already-resolved'. The team's purse is NOT debited (the bid update happened earlier — but the ownership write that triggers downstream purse handling does not). Operator triage required.

acceptanceCriteria.given: an open club bid whose timer has expired with zero auctionBidLogs.type='bid' rows
acceptanceCriteria.then: auctionBids.status flips to 'unsold', an auctionBidLogs 'unsold' row with amount=0 is appended, no auctionClubOwnership row is created, and no purse is deducted

acceptanceCriteria.given: resolveClubBid is invoked twice in quick succession on the same open bid
acceptanceCriteria.then: it returns 'already-resolved' and produces no duplicate ownership/log rows

acceptanceCriteria.given: a team that already has an auctionClubOwnership row in the league
acceptanceCriteria.then: the team's id is omitted from the returned list, regardless of bidding state

acceptanceCriteria.given: an attempt to insert a second auctionClubOwnership row for the same league+teamId or league+plTeamId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the uniqueIndex constraint rejects the row

acceptanceCriteria.given: a simulated auction league with 6 non-ghost teams and 20 PL clubs
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly 6 auctionClubOwnership rows are inserted at £500K each, teams.purse decreases and teams.totalSpent increases by £500K per team, the session is marked 'completed' and writeAuctionCompleteSnapshot is invoked

acceptanceCriteria.given: simulateClubAuction is called on a non-club-auction session
acceptanceCriteria.then: it throws Error('simulateClubAuction called on a non-club-auction session') and writes no rows

acceptanceCriteria.given: a PL team id present in PL_STANDINGS_SEED_TOP8 / _MID / _PROMOTED respectively
acceptanceCriteria.then: it returns 'top8' / 'mid' / 'promoted' and returns null for unknown ids

acceptanceCriteria.given: auctionClubOwnership has been persisted at purchase time
acceptanceCriteria.when: the standings config is later edited to move that plTeamId to a different tier
acceptanceCriteria.then: the snapshotted tier on auctionClubOwnership does NOT change (snapshot survives later config edits)

defects.title: POST /api/auction/redeem-slot blocks superadmin while POST /unlock-slot allows it
defects.description: POST /api/auction/redeem-slot rejects any session whose type is not 'team' (src/app/api/auction/redeem-slot/route.ts:103). POST /api/auction/unlock-slot accepts either a team session OR a superadmin cookie (src/app/api/auction/unlock-slot/route.ts:25-31, 39-42). The two sibling endpoints have asymmetric admin contracts.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either both endpoints accept superadmin (so admins can support teams who can't log in), or both refuse — but the two should be consistent.
defects.actualBehaviour: Superadmins can unlock bonus slots on behalf of any team but cannot redeem penalty slots on behalf of any team; admin gets 401 'Team authentication required' from redeem-slot.
defects.notes: Fix options: (a) add an `isSuperAdmin(request)` bypass to redeem-slot mirroring unlock-slot; or (b) document that admin support is intentionally write-restricted for penalty redemption. Option (a) is the lower-risk default. Risk/impact: blocks admin-side recovery when a team locks itself out mid-cycle.

defects.title: redeem-slot does not decrement teams.purse column; unlock-slot does — purse column drifts
defects.description: POST /api/auction/unlock-slot decrements teams.purse via SQL alongside totalSpent (src/app/api/auction/unlock-slot/route.ts:118-127). POST /api/auction/redeem-slot only updates teams.penaltySlots and teams.totalSpent — it does NOT touch teams.purse (src/app/api/auction/redeem-slot/route.ts:188-196). Because the canonical purse is computed by calculatePurse(initialBudget,totalIncome,totalSpent,totalRefunds), the stored teams.purse column will diverge over time depending on which endpoints have run.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either both endpoints maintain teams.purse as a denormalised cache (decrement on every cost), or neither does (and reads use calculatePurse). Behaviour must be uniform across all economy-affecting endpoints.
defects.actualBehaviour: After a penalty redemption, teams.purse is stale by `cost` until some other code path refreshes it; after an unlock, teams.purse reflects the deduction immediately. UI surfaces that read teams.purse directly (vs. computing it) will show inconsistent numbers depending on which path the team last took.
defects.notes: Fix options: (a) add `purse: sql\`${teams.purse} - ${cost}\`` to the redeem-slot UPDATE so behaviour matches unlock-slot; or (b) drop the column-level decrement from unlock-slot and have every consumer call calculatePurse on read. Option (a) preserves existing UI assumptions; option (b) eliminates an entire class of drift bug but is broader. Risk/impact: money/economy integrity — players see wrong purse values; trade/unlock guards downstream may use the wrong source.

defects.title: Schema column comment on teamSlotUnlocks.slotNumber is stale ('15 or 16') and bonusSlots comment mentions £25M legacy price
defects.description: src/lib/db/schema.ts:525 documents teamSlotUnlocks.slotNumber as '15 or 16'; route code writes 16/17/18 (src/app/api/auction/unlock-slot/route.ts:114). src/lib/db/schema.ts:113-114 mentions a legacy £25M price; current code uses £10M/£20M/£30M (src/lib/formats/auction/squad-rules.ts:11). The doc comment block above POST /unlock-slot (src/app/api/auction/unlock-slot/route.ts:18-22) is also out of date — refers to 'slot 15, then 16'.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Comments match code: slot numbers stored are 16/17/18; bonus-slot prices are £10M/£20M/£30M.
defects.actualBehaviour: Documentation conflicts with implementation, which can confuse downstream readers, QA, and finance ledger consumers reading slotNumber.
defects.notes: Documentation-only — no runtime impact. Update three comment blocks to match current pricing/slot indices. [DEV] Self-verified: cleanup-only fix; no behaviour change. [QA-VERIFIED] Inverted pinning TC(s). [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: Updated stale schema comments in src/lib/db/schema.ts: teamSlotUnlocks.slotNumber comment now reads '16, 17, or 18' (was '15 or 16'); the teams.bonusSlots block-comment now references squad-rules.ts as the canonical pricing source and drops the legacy 25M / slot-15 references. No behaviour change.

defects.title: resolveTier null fallback hard-coded to 'mid' in club-bid resolution masks misconfigured standings
defects.description: When resolveClubBid creates an auctionClubOwnership row on SOLD, it calls resolveTier(fresh.fplElementId, config) and falls back to 'mid' if the PL team id is in none of the standings lists (src/lib/formats/auction/club-auction.ts:439-440). resolveTier itself is documented to return null only if the team isn't in any tier list ('shouldn't happen for the 20 PL clubs' — src/lib/data/pl-standings-seed.ts:42-44). The silent fallback means a misconfigured plStandingsConfig (e.g. a 19-club list after a manual edit, or a season-rollover seed mismatch) results in the owning team getting 'mid' scoring quietly instead of an error or admin alert.
defects.expectedBehaviour: Either fail the resolution and surface the misconfiguration to the admin, or log a loud warning so it can be corrected before the season scores any GWs.
defects.actualBehaviour: Owner team silently gets 'mid' tier with no log line, no notification, no admin alert. simulateClubAuction takes a stricter approach (it skips and warns — src/lib/formats/auction/club-auction.ts:625-631), so the two flows are inconsistent.
defects.notes: Fix options: (a) match simulateClubAuction — refuse to write an ownership row with a null tier and emit a warning; (b) emit a notification to superadmin when fallback triggers; (c) accept current behaviour but log at warn level. Risk/impact: incorrect club-result bonus scoring for the affected team for the rest of the season; hard to detect after the fact because the row still looks valid. [DEV] Self-verified: tsc clean. [QA-VERIFIED] Pinning TC(s) inverted. [BA-UPDATED] BR/AC text refreshed.
defects.resolution: resolveClubBid no longer falls back to 'mid' when resolveTier returns null (src/lib/formats/auction/club-auction.ts:438-466). On null tier the route logs an error to the console, writes a sold audit-log entry for the bid, and returns 'already-resolved' WITHOUT inserting an auctionClubOwnership row. The standings config is misconfigured if this happens — superadmin must repair it and re-allocate via auction-corrections. Silent 'mid' fallback that masked the misconfiguration is gone.
